purpose: Exploratory same-read sensitivity of the original automatic prompt conditioning memory to its prompt-mask foreground, background and boundary regions, motivated by its high attention mass and suspected poor automatic prompts. This does not propose conditioning pruning during video propagation.
data: The existing four frozen reads each for seq8, seq11, seq20 and seq23; seq23 uses the fixed inset-free crop. Prior reads, prompts and outcomes have been inspected. Target labels are not used to select or replay memory tokens and are opened only after predictions are frozen.
region_definition: Area-resize the original automatically predicted prompt mask to the 64x64 memory grid. Rank cells by soft predicted foreground occupancy, inverse occupancy or occupancy times one minus occupancy; break ties by deterministic bit-reversed spatial order. These are approximate spatial roles, not ground-truth polyp/background classifications. Zero-to-one scores are used for ranking, not as a confidence decision or new threshold.
arms: No-op; remove exactly 1024 of 4096 conditioning tokens selected by foreground occupancy, background occupancy, boundary occupancy, deterministic spatial uniformity, fixed-shuffled occupancy, or highest captured full-read last-layer attention usage. The latter is a retrospective same-read oracle control requiring the full attention read, not a deployable single-pass selector. All deletion arms have the same key count. Every other memory token, object pointer, position vector and decoder input is unchanged.
verification: Reproduce full attention, decoder and no-op prediction exactly on each frozen read. First run two independent label-free seq3 gates. Unit-test identity, ranks and position/pointer preservation; check conditioning position grid and exact deleted key counts; repeat priority replays in fresh processes, independently verify ranks and re-score all masks. Report last-layer pre-removal mass of each selected set, per-frame and per-sequence present Dice and labeled-empty false alarms.
interpretation: Attention mass is not causal importance. Deletion measures conditional local sensitivity with changed softmax normalization, not usefulness of a persistent memory strategy. Differences between artificial token deletions do not directly establish an automatic prompt improvement or independent patient generalization. Historical 1024 conditioning-retention trials substantially harmed seq8, so no online prompt-memory change is implied.
